title: Unbox. Slip it into your pocket. Start rolling. 🎥｜Osmo Pocket 4

author: DJI
description:
Unleash unrivaled cinematic versatility with the Osmo Pocket 4P's innovative dual-camera system, meticulously engineered to capture breathtaking visuals – from sweeping landscapes to intricate close-ups.
Its wide-angle lens features an all-new 1-inch CMOS sensor, delivering an impressive 17-stop dynamic range for unparalleled detail and clarity. Harness the power of the brand- new 10-bit D-Log 2 color mode, unlocking boundless creative freedom for post-production. The 60mm med-tele lens with an F1.8 aperture crafts natural, cinematic bokeh, elevating portraits with stunning depth and definition. Capture highlight moments with 4K/240fps slow motion, and make unforgettable cinematic sequences.
Simply slip it into your pocket and unlock an entirely new dimension of cinematic storytelling – wherever inspiration strikes.

✅ Dual Cameras | Cinematic Shots Near & Far
✅ Enhanced 1-Inch CMOS & 17-Stop Dynamic Range
✅ Classic Focal Length for Standout Portraits
✅ New D-Log 2 | Light & Shadow Pr
